items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Did they have Peter Bocca or whatever?

ctx.x: I don't remember all the guys. I didn't even know who they were when I was there. I remember Sheik and Henry was there. I think Sheik was with the band wasn't he? I think she was with the band. Sheik, Poesy.
Did they have Peter Bocca or whatever?
Yeah, he was one of them. I can't remember all the guys. I wonder if it wasn't Booker T playing?
